camel_example: aliyun iot GisQueryDeviceLocation --region cn-hangzhou --ThingList.1.DeviceName mock_device_name --ThingList.1.ProductKey g3r0000Vjta
description_en: Queries the location information of devices
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备位置信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot gis-query-device-location --thing-list ProductKey=g3r0000Vjta DeviceName=mock_device_name --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GisQueryDeviceLocation

fields.help_en:
The list of device names to query.
<notice>The ProductKey and DeviceName of each device must be specified together, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
要查询的设备名列表。
<notice>每个设备的 ProductKey与DeviceName必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
</notice>
fields.name: device_name

fields.help_en:
The list of ProductKeys of the products to which the devices belong.
A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a product. You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html.
<notice>The ProductKey and DeviceName of each device must be specified together, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey列表。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice>每个设备的 ProductKey与DeviceName必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
</notice>
fields.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The response code. 200 indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 200表示成功。其它表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The location information of the devices returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回设备的位置信息

Adcode.description_en:
The AMAP adcode. For adcode information, refer to the city code table.

The city code table was last updated on July 27, 2020. This table is used to query the codes corresponding to different cities. It is for reference only. We recommend that you use online services such as address resolution to obtain the latest codes in real time. Administrative region code queries for Taiwan (China) are not supported.
Download link (https://a.amap.com/lbs/static/amap_3dmap_lite/AMap_adcode_citycode.zip)
Adcode.description_zh:
高德adcode,adcode信息可参考城市编码表。

城市编码表，更新于2020年7月27日，该表用于查询不同城市对应的编码。仅供查询使用，建议通过地址解析等线上服务实时获取最新编码。暂时不支持台湾省的行政区域编码查询。
下载链接 (https://a.amap.com/lbs/static/amap_3dmap_lite/AMap_adcode_citycode.zip)

City.description_en: The city where the device is located

CoordinateSystem.description_en:
The coordinate type.

1: WGS_84, the international longitude and latitude coordinate system.
2: GCJ_02, a coordinate system developed by the National Administration of Surveying, Mapping and Geoinformation of China that applies initial encryption to geographic locations
CoordinateSystem.description_zh:
坐标类型。

1：WGS_84，国际经纬度坐标系统。
2：GCJ_02，由国测局制定，是对地理位置进行首次加密后的一种坐标系统

Country.description_en: The country where the device is located

Ip.description_en: The IP address used when the device goes online

Latitude.description_en: The latitude of the device location

Longitude.description_en: The longitude of the device location

ProductKey.description_en: The productKey of the product to which the device belongs

Province.description_en: The province where the device is located

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails. This field is not returned if the call succeeds
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息，如果调用成功，没有ErrorMessage字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
